name: aisreact
description: An open-source platform for observing how different AI models react to real-world news and events

scripts.dev: npm run check:node && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.setup: npm run check:node && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend

author: aisreact.com contributors
